output: Median queue time was 18 minutes during 1–13 May 2026, before the routing change on 14 May, and 12 minutes during 15–28 May, after the change. No data was collected on 14 May. Staffing also increased on 15 May, so the figures do not isolate routing’s effect.

Monthly recurring revenue was $240,000 as of 30 June 2026. The September planning model forecasts $310,000 per month by 31 December 2026 if both scheduled launches proceed. That forecast is not booked revenue; neither launch had occurred by 30 June.

You qualify for the legacy credit if your account was opened on or before 31 March 2026 and you submit your claim from 1 April through 30 April 2026, inclusive. Accounts opened on or after 1 April 2026 do not qualify, even if you claim during April. Claims submitted after 30 April are ineligible, regardless of when the account was opened.

The January survey found 62% satisfaction among 120 first-time customers. The April survey found 74% satisfaction among 90 returning customers. These are different cohorts, not repeated measurements of the same customers, so the results do not establish that customer satisfaction improved over time.

On 6 August 2026, monitoring recorded the first error at 08:42 UTC and recovery at 09:03 UTC. Engineering reports that mitigation began at 08:45 UTC, but this time has not been verified against the deployment log. Support reported receiving the first customer complaint at 08:47 UTC; that is not the outage’s start time.

Checkout completion rose from 61% in the week of 2 November to 66% in the week of 9 November 2026. The simpler payment form launched on 9 November, alongside a shipping discount and a new advertising campaign, so this comparison cannot attribute the increase to the form.
We received the supplier file on 11 October 2026. Priya is scheduled to check it on 13 October 2026. The client review is scheduled for 23 October 2026, and corrections are due on 25 October 2026.

The records give three acceptance dates: 18 February 2026 on the signed acceptance form, 20 February 2026 in the project tracker, and 19 February 2026 on the invoice. We have not established whether these reflect different milestones or a date-entry error. No single acceptance date is settled until the owner confirms.
Version 4.2 became available for optional download on 3 September 2026. Automatic updates began on 10 September. Devices that remained offline had not necessarily updated by either date.

The totals are not directly comparable because the reports cover different time windows and count different orders. The earlier report covers three months, 1 January–31 March 2026, and includes all 480 orders placed during that period, including cancellations. The newer report covers two months, 1 April–31 May 2026, and includes only 290 shipped orders, excluding cancellations and orders still awaiting shipment. These differences mean the totals alone cannot establish a trend in order volume.

Your trial access lasts through 23:59 UTC on 30 November 2026. To keep access, activate a paid plan before 00:00 UTC on 1 December 2026. Otherwise, access stops at that time. A paid plan is optional: your trial will not convert automatically, and you will not be charged automatically.

As of 16:00 UTC on 7 July 2026, 34 of the 50 scheduled inspections were complete. That count does not include inspections finished after 16:00. The team expects to complete the remaining 16 by 9 July; completion by that date has not yet been confirmed.
